About
Music Store Bilong Yumi
Online Music Platform for Papua New Guinea
About the App
Music Store Bilong Yumi is Papua New Guinea's premier online music platform, designed to empower local artists and connect them with music lovers across the nation and beyond.
Our platform provides artists with powerful tools to create, master, and distribute their music while earning fair compensation for their work. With integrated AI music creation, professional mastering presets, and multiple payment options including PayPal, Stripe, and PNG phone banking, we make it easy for PNG artists to share their talent with the world.
How to Use
1. Create Your Account
Sign up with your email to access all features. One email = one account.
2. Upload Your Music
Upload audio files, cover art, and music videos. Free users get 7 uploads, premium users get unlimited.
3. Use AI Music Creator
Describe the music you want to create and let our AI generate unique tracks for you.
4. Master Your Tracks
Use professional mastering presets to enhance your sound. 4 free presets available, more with premium.
5. Set Your Price
Choose to offer your music for free or set a price in Papua New Guinea Kina (PGK).
6. Earn Money
Receive 95% of every sale directly to your PayPal or BSP account. The platform takes only 5% to maintain operations.
